title: REQ · HeaderOverlay sound toggle and settings are wired to useUiStore
summary: Sound toggle and settings buttons read and write uiStore
description: Context: uiStore exposes soundEnabled, settingsOpen, toggleSound and toggleSettings. Desired behavior: HeaderOverlay shows a sound button whose icon and aria-pressed reflect soundEnabled and calls toggleSound on click, and a settings button that calls toggleSettings. Expected result: clicking changes store state. Why: header controls must drive shared UI state, not local state.
acceptance_criteria: Given soundEnabled true, When the 'Toggle sound' button is clicked, Then store soundEnabled is false and aria-pressed reflects the state
Given settingsOpen false, When the 'Settings' button is clicked, Then store settingsOpen is true

in_scope: Sound and settings buttons in HeaderOverlay

technical_constraints: Use useUiStore selectors; lucide Volume2, VolumeX, Settings icons
definition_of_done: Controls wired to the real store
